name: read-data-types-layer
description: A generic `read` at layer granularity over `implementation_types` (`data_types` until contract `8.0.0`) — the layer the 39-tool MCP surface has no read tool for at all. The read half of the motivating gap closes by addressing, not by a tenth `read_*` tool. The request names `form: full` explicitly, because a layer address answers a summary by default.

context.summary: A project whose `implementation_types` layer (`data_types/implementation/`) holds two value types that rest on the base type `float32_base`, which the `base_types` layer declares: `float32`, which `IExample`'s data element is typed by, and `VehicleSpeed_kph`. The layer is readable by address even though no `read_data_types` tool exists, because `read` takes an address rather than a layer-shaped signature.

value.name: VehicleSpeed_kph
value.description: Vehicle speed in kilometres per hour

expected.notes: A layer address is `{layer}` with no `element`; the answer is the layer's elements in the declared field vocabulary, each carrying its `kind` discriminator. Ordering is the registry's, not the client's. `form` is stated explicitly BECAUSE a layer address defaults to `summary`: this vector pins the full width, so the value below is the whole layer and stays byte-identical whatever the default becomes.
